 (FE, HG, LL)

**Answer: (EU, GW, KB)**

questions.q: What was the last day of the year 1881?
questions.solution:
Calendar calculation places 31 December 1881 on a Saturday.

**Answer: Saturday**

questions.q: 7 teachers A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting in a row facing north (not necessarily in the same order). B is fifth to the left of E. A is fifth to the left of G. D is third to the left of E. C is second to the right of D. Who are the immediate neighbours of A?
questions.solution:
The only arrangement meeting every condition is B, A, D, F, C, E, G. Therefore B and D are the immediate neighbours of A.

**Answer: B and D**
